# velero-metrics.txt — REAL /metrics of the Velero server on a live OpenShift cluster,
# OADP 1.5.8 (Velero v1.16.1-OADP), captured 2026-09-30 via port-forward to
# openshift-adp-velero-metrics-svc:8085 (tests/METRICS-CAPTURE.md). Unmodified: it contains
# only generic schedule names. State at capture: one schedule, its only backup PartiallyFailed,
# no Completed backup present — note velero_backup_last_status is 1 regardless (docs/design.md F2).
